idea: Monotone-staircase DP: on an L×L integer board, restrict layouts to those built by placing squares into the inner corners of a Young-diagram-shaped occupied region growing from the bottom-left corner. States are monotone lattice paths, giving far fewer states than general skyline search, so L can reach about 20–24. This finds non-guillotine integer dissections, such as corner-heavy optima, exactly.
